import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    return (params[0] + params[1]*t + params[2]*t**2 + (params[3] + params[4]*t + params[5]*t**2)*P
            + (params[6] + params[7]*t)*P**2 + params[8]*np.exp(-params[9]*t))
